# No new libraries without approval

Coding rule · `M18`

Import only declared deps; no second library for a covered job (dropdown: customPackage/react-native-select-dropdown; modal: react-native-modal/AppConfirmModal; toast: react-native-toast-message; distance: geolib; dates: moment per D1). New deps need owner approval
